item.summary: Norwegian Block Exchange (NBX) and Aprikos Venture have signed a joint venture for a planned Pakistan crypto exchange, Nayapaisa, and have applied to the Pakistan Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority for a No Objection Certificate, according to the companies as reported by Kaupr. The application is the first step in a licensing process, and the exchange will not serve customers until both the certificate and a licence are granted. The plan is to offer deposits and withdrawals in Pakistani rupees through licensed Pakistani banks.
